verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents on-call schedules, rotations and preserved schedule overrides, but nothing in the evidence shows shifts being exported to a personal calendar through an iCal/ICS feed or calendar sync. The Google Calendar integration mentioned is for meeting transcription, an unrelated feature, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook
